details: pi (nktkt) is a Rust port of the earendil-works/pi coding agent harness, focused on the core coding-agent loop. The TypeScript upstream is roughly 189k lines; this port covers the agent runtime, a multi-provider LLM API, and a working pi CLI end to end, talking to Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with SSE streaming, retry, cancellation tokens, and a per-tool permission gate. The CLI offers print mode, an interactive REPL with streaming render, session persistence with resume, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md loading, slash commands, and a yolo flag to skip permission prompts. The pi-ai and pi-agent crates are published on crates.io for reuse; MIT-licensed.
